snippet.title: Dogfight! Magnavox Odyssey 1972
snippet.description:
Dogfight! is the first shooter video game released for Magnavox Odyssey in 1972 and sold with a light gun (rifle). It uses the game card 9 and an overlay.

One player moves their dot along a flight path on the overlay, while the other player attempts to shoot it with the light gun.

When one player has finished his flight, the two players trade roles

The winner is the player who scores the most hits.

Source: https://archive.org/details/OdySim/page/20/mode/2up

Gameplay: OdySim Simulator 1080p 60 FPS
